in_hebrew.name: Vasilis
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Royal, Wise, Bringer of Good
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Vasilis הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Vasilis is a Greek name derived from the word basileus, meaning 'king'. It was a common name in ancient Greece and Rome, and was often given to boys born into royal families. The name is also associated with the Greek god Dionysus, who was known as the 'bringer of good' and the 'god of wine'. In Christianity, Vasilis is a variant of the name Basil, which means 'royal' or 'wise'.
